name: Bundle-aware Spend & Save % settings
description: Configure bundle simulation and spend-and-save percentage tiers
title: Bundle-aware Spend & Save %
helpText: Simulate collection-pair bundles for min-spend eligibility, then apply a percentage to eligible units that did not form a pair.
bundleHelpText: Must match the live collection-pair / hoodie bundle discount settings so artificial spend stays accurate.
noMarkets: No markets found for this store.
singlePriceNote: Any two products from the collection are treated as a fixed total in your store currency when calculating artificial spend. Discount is split proportionally by each product's price.
marketsPriceNote: Enable markets individually. Pair totals use that market's fixed price when calculating artificial spend.
eligibleCollectionHelp: Products that can receive the percentage. Leave empty to allow all products. Units that formed a simulated pair never receive the percentage.
spendSavePercentCsvHelp: Shop-currency spend|percent pairs, comma-separated. Example: 75|15,150|20,200|30. Highest unlocked tier wins.
discountMessageHelp: Shown on discounted lines. Use [discountAmount] for the unlocked percent, e.g. Spend & Save [discountAmount]%.
error: Unable to save settings. Please try again.
